address: Laan Van Meerdervoort 6, The Hague, 2517 AJ, Netherlands
bio: Villa Coucou radiates sophistication: hardwood floors, marble tables, and artwork on the walls create a luxurious setting. Start with an aperitif at the bar or in the wine cellar (with its own pétanque court!) before heading upstairs to admire the garden vista. The chef specialises in French classics with a playful twist: tomato terrine with basil ice cream and goat's cheese foam, or succulent ribeye with grilled sweetcorn and a herb-scented jus. A single set menu is served at lunchtime; both à la carte and a set menu are available in the evening. This chic spot might just become your new favourite....
